title: Spec: CLI agent flags, env defaults, and display
description:
As an AI agent using Kanbus CLI, I want to tag creates and comments with platform, model, and settings, so that provenance appears in human-readable output when present.

## Gherkin

See also proposed `features/agent/agent_metadata.feature` and additions to `features/issues/issue_show.feature`.

```gherkin
Feature: Agent metadata CLI
  As an AI agent using Kanbus
  I want CLI flags and environment defaults for agent metadata
  So that I can record provenance without cluttering default output

  Scenario: Create issue with agent metadata via flags
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    And the current user is "agent"
    When I run "kanbus create \"Agent task\" --type task --agent-platform cursor --agent-model composer-2.5"
    Then the command should succeed
    And stdout should contain "Agent: cursor / composer-2.5"

  Scenario: Create without agent metadata omits Agent row
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    When I run "kanbus create \"Plain task\" --type task"
    Then stdout should not contain "Agent:"

  Scenario: Comment inherits agent metadata from environment
    Given a Kanbus project with default configuration
    And an issue "kanbus-aaa" exists
    And KANBUS_AGENT_PLATFORM is set to "cursor"
    And KANBUS_AGENT_MODEL is set to "composer-2.5"
    When I run "kanbus comment kanbus-aaa \"Progress note\""
    Then the latest comment should have agent platform "cursor" and model "composer-2.5"

  Scenario: CLI flags override agent environment variables
    Given KANBUS_AGENT_PLATFORM is set to "cursor"
    When I run "kanbus comment kanbus-aaa \"Override\" --agent-platform codex --agent-model gpt-5"
    Then the latest comment should have agent platform "codex"

  Scenario: Invalid agent settings JSON fails
    When I run "kanbus comment kanbus-aaa \"Bad\" --agent-settings not-json"
    Then stderr should contain "invalid agent settings"

  Scenario: Show JSON includes agent metadata when present
    Given issue "kanbus-agent" exists with agent platform "cursor" and model "composer-2.5"
    When I run "kanbus show kanbus-agent --json"
    Then stdout should contain "\"agent\""
    And stdout should contain "\"platform\": \"cursor\""

  Scenario: Comment display includes agent suffix when present
    Given issue "kanbus-c" has a comment from "agent" with text "Done" and agent platform "cursor" and model "composer-2.5"
    When I format issue "kanbus-c" for display
    Then the formatted output should contain text "agent (cursor / composer-2.5):"
```

## Display format

Issue header (when present):

```
Agent: cursor / composer-2.5
  settings: temperature=0.2, thinking_level=high
```

Comment line (when present):

```
  [abc123] agent (cursor / composer-2.5): Implemented token refresh
```
